text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while cleaning the trainer's office,
a notebook fell off the desk...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was the time when we designed Epiphaneia's racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I'm leaving the design of my racing outfit to you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! 
You will design it from scratch!
choice_data_list: What!? I've never done that before!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing you, who understands me so well, you can do it!
Even the voice of destiny says so!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In other words, no one is more suited for this than you!
I'm counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept along by the momentum, I ended up having to think of
a design for the racing silks.
That said, I have nowhere to start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "So, we decided to visit places connected to her to look for design inspiration."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that brings back memories!
Mom and I used to play tag right here, didn't we?
choice_data_list: It's quite a steep slope, though.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: A place like this is the only thing that could satisfy me! I just had way too much energy to burn!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Shall we give it a shot for old time's sake! Let's go, Trainer!!
choice_data_list: No, no, it wouldn't even be a contest!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This is my absolute favorite among all our villas.
The mountain out back makes the perfect playground!
choice_data_list: I see... Wait, even inside the villa?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The beachside villa where you can swim anytime and the hilltop one with the panoramic night view are great, but...
This one is the most fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spent a considerable amount of time delving into Epiphaneia's personal side.
Eventually, the design was finished, but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's really well made, so full of energy!
It feels totally like me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, please restart it from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it!
I'm counting on you to make a racing outfit only you, as my Trainer, can create!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: There's still higher ground to reach!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "It's gotten way better! We're just getting started!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Revising it over and over again.
Until I couldn't think of anything more to add—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Is the new one ready, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, my bad! I was just eager to see it!
So, how is it!?
choice_data_list: Sorry... I might not be able to take it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no point in trying to cover it up.
I confessed honestly that my mind had gone completely blank...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: “I see... Then let's eat something sweet to refresh our mood!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"As a special treat, I'll cook for you today!
Excuse the intrusion!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sugar, eggs... and butter too!
Let's make pancakes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing it was Epiphaneia doing the cooking,
I had a feeling this wouldn't be ordinary culinary work.
I'd better watch her closely...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Doryaaaaah!
Mix, mix! Become delicious--!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, the amount went down!
Wah! The floor is all soggy...!
choice_data_list: Let's mix it focusing more on power than speed!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Hraaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to bake it!
Heat on MAX—
choice_data_list: Leave the heat to me! Just focus on flipping them!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm counting on you!
Haha, burn, burn, burn~~!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Done! My special homemade pancakes!
Go ahead, dig in!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, we did it—!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“This proves it, though.
Leaving our racewear to our Trainer really is the right call!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"These pancakes turned out great.
Though on my own, they would've been a disaster."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I tend to overdo things, after all!
You're the one who kept me under control.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"What I want from my racewear is the exact same thing.
I want it to complement and make up for what I lack!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Fill in the missing pieces, Trainer!
Make this a flawless first-place finish, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then I can run full speed ahead!
With you and the voice of destiny pushing me forward, all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia's greatest asset
is her powerful energy.
To that, I'll add my perspective as a Trainer.
choice_data_list: Let's make it... a racing outfit for me and Epiphaneia!
Let's make it... a racing outfit for me and Epiphaneia!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Epi!? Why are you in your racing outfit...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I just suddenly felt like wearing it, okay!
Is it really something to be that surprised about?
choice_data_list: Because I was just remembering my racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a coincidence... no, maybe it was inevitable!
Because I heard the voice of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's such a great design!
I gotta show it to Trainer, too!
choice_data_list: I feel like I heard it too.
I think I heard it too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's such a great design!
I gotta show it to Trainer, too!
choice_data_list: I feel like I heard it too.
I think I heard it too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I see! Well then, could it sound like this too?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "The future I'll run towards in this racing attire is shining so brightly it's almost blinding!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it?!
It's perfect for me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You know me best, and you're the one who designed it!
